assertions: Every emitted observation is supported by an explicit lexical or structural cue.
Punctuation alone and generic declarative form never force a classification.
Clear questions, procedural formulas, concessions, qualifications, definitions, examples, assertive markers, and Phase 4 quotations are represented.
Multiple compatible observations may be emitted for one utterance.
Evidence spans reproduce exact Phase 4 display text and retain source-media addressing.
Phase 4 quotation evidence is consumed without changing acoustic speaker attribution.
Rule confidence is explicitly uncalibrated and is not treated as provider probability.
The baseline invokes no provider and performs no semantic claim extraction.
Builds replay deterministically and sealed persistence refuses tampering or incompatible quotation lineage.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, list observations, and list unclassified utterances.
Phase 4 and earlier evidence remains byte-for-byte outside the output destination.
limitations: The deterministic fixture qualifies conservative mechanics, not general natural-conversation accuracy.
Recall is intentionally limited before provider-assisted classification.
Partial-span media timing remains at utterance resolution when word-to-character alignment is unavailable.
